Host and funder

The selected organisation is the research host. FAPESP provides the fellowship funding; applicants should follow the project-specific eligibility and submission instructions in the official call.

About the Fellowship

FICOSS-AI uses artificial intelligence in research on stellar populations and galaxy evolution. The role is based at ITA in São José dos Campos and involves scientific programming and astronomical data analysis within an interdisciplinary research team.

Research Areas

  • Astronomy
  • Galaxy evolution
  • Artificial intelligence

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPostdoctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryFAPESP postdoctoral fellowship with a published allowance of BRL 12,570; confirm payment terms and eligibility in the official call.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Academic preparationPhD in astronomy, physics, computer science, data science or a related subject.
Further conditionsRelevant PhD in astronomy, physics, computing or data science; all nationalities.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round2 November 2026
LocationBrazil
Details checked9 October 2026

How to Apply

  1. Email your CV, publication list and a brief research-interest statement to duiliademello@ita.br.
  2. Use the subject “FICOSS-AI Postdoctoral Application” and ask two referees to send recommendations directly to the same address.
  3. Complete the submission by 2 November 2026; research is on site at ITA in São José dos Campos.

About São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP)

FAPESP funds research in São Paulo, Brazil, and publishes fellowship opportunities attached to research projects. Applicants follow the host project's submission instructions and the foundation's fellowship eligibility rules.
